xBRIEFInfo.description: Proposed post-MVP advanced Directive elective scope
xBRIEFInfo.author: agent:deft-directive-setup

narratives.Description: Develop advanced electives only after learners can complete one solo Directive lifecycle. These modules are explicitly outside the initial MVP and must not displace beginner-path completion or pilot revision.
narratives.Acceptance: Future electives may cover brownfield adoption and upgrades, backlog refinement and reconciliation, swarm-ready decomposition, worktrees and multi-agent allocation, dispatch contracts and model routing, review monitors and merge-path ownership, bounded autonomy and dual stops, decisions and provenance, feedback and continuous improvement, host/runtime operations, release and deployment workflows, and framework-maintainer internals. Each elective must state its advanced prerequisites and satisfy the same self-directed evidence, recovery, and solution contracts.
narratives.QualityGate: Run task deft:check separately as the aggregate merge chokepoint after the literal acceptance command; do not embed the aggregate gate in plan.acceptance.commands.

items.title: Prioritize and shape advanced elective tracks

narrative.Acceptance: Electives are prioritized from validated learner and maintainer needs, explicitly gated on solo-lifecycle competence, and split into independently teachable scopes before implementation.

items.title: Deliver approved advanced modules with isolated exercises

narrative.Acceptance: Each authorized elective is current-version traceable, self-directed, safe, isolated from business repositories, and contains observable evidence, hints, recovery, assessment, and an explained solution.
